tickets.title: Send education account setup outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Introduce the education account setup process and gather the information needed to evaluate options such as a 529 plan or other education savings vehicle.

Suggested message outline:
Hello Mira and Jonas Quillwhistle,

We can help evaluate and set up an education savings account for Lila Quillwhistle. To get started, please share:
- Beneficiary full legal name: Lila Quillwhistle
- Beneficiary relationship to account owner: [placeholder]
- Beneficiary state of residence: [placeholder]
- Account owner: [placeholder]
- Desired initial contribution or funding plan: An initial funding amount from cash reserves, with possible recurring contributions
- Expected recurring contribution, if any: [placeholder]
- Investment risk preference or time horizon: [placeholder]
- Any state tax, gifting, or financial aid questions to review: Mira wants education funding to cover about half of a public university cost while preserving flexibility if Lila chooses another path.

If another professional should be included, such as the client's CPA, attorney, or education planning contact, confirm permission and preferred contact details before outreach.

Next step: Once we have the details, we will outline available account structure choices and setup instructions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that education funding account structure outline by 2026-02-20.

tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial documents
tickets.text:
Use this checklist to coordinate divorce document requests:

- Confirm the client's attorney or mediator contact information and communication permissions.
- Identify required financial statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance policies, estate documents, and debt records.
- Check that requested documents cover the relevant lookback period without using fixed calendar deadlines in the template.
- Separate joint, individual, business, retirement, and trust-related documents.
- Verify whether any restricted stock, options, deferred compensation, or pension benefits need special documentation.
- Track missing items and responsible party for each document.
- Confirm secure delivery method before transmitting any sensitive materials.
- Save copies and notes to the appropriate client file location.

For Mira and Jonas Quillwhistle, organize adoption-related tax records, childcare deposit evidence, dependent information, and any employer benefit elections for CPA Alina Dewspindle’s spring preparation cutoff.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for the CPA packet is due 2026-03-10.
